newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland cuts min price of 10-yr bonds to 98.60.
newsitem.headline: Poland cuts min price of 10-yr bonds to 98.60.

text.p: Poland cut the minimum price on its 10-year floating bonds to 98.60 from 98.90 at the last tender in March, and sold 15 million zlotys of the paper against a 700 million zloty offer, the finance ministry said.
It said the minimum price of 98.60 was the same for both the bonds maturing on April 18, 2006 and on April 18, 2007.
The ministry offered 300 million zlotys worth of the shorter paper, which had an average price of 98.75 and 400 million zlotys of the longer paper with an average price of 99.05.
The ministry sold 13 million zlotys worth of the shorter paper on demand of 77 million and two million zlotys of the longer bonds on demand of 49.6 million zlotys.
